intro: Amman rewards visitors with Roman ruins, a buzzing downtown and easy day trips across Jordan. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: No metro or tram; the BRT bus network is the fast backbone, about 0.610 JOD a ride.
City buses are cheap but often Arabic-only; pay exact fare or swipe a Visa or MasterCard.
Yellow and grey taxis use meters; most trips in town stay under 2-5 JOD.
Uber and Careem both work well in Amman; core rides cost about 1-4 JOD.
Driving is common but traffic is heavy; car rental desks are at the airport and in town.
Walking is patchy: steep hills, missing sidewalks and few crossings, so plan some rides. No ferry service.

citadel.name: Amman Citadel (Jabal al-Qal'a)
citadel.price_text: ≈ JOD 2–3 entry; Jordan Pass covers it
citadel.hours: Daily roughly 08:00–18:00 in summer, shorter in winter — check on the day
citadel.tip: Go early or near sunset for cool air and the best view over Downtown.

roman-theater.name: Roman Theater
roman-theater.price_text: ≈ JOD 2 entry; small extra for the folklore museums
roman-theater.hours: Daily roughly 08:00–17:00 — check on the day
roman-theater.tip: Climb to the top rows for the view, then walk five minutes to the souq.

downtown-souq.name: Downtown Amman Souq
downtown-souq.price_text: Free to walk; bring cash for snacks and spices
downtown-souq.hours: Shops roughly 09:00–20:00; quiet on Friday mornings
downtown-souq.tip: Come hungry for falafel and knafeh, and bargain politely on prices.

madaba-map.name: Madaba Map (St George's Church)
madaba-map.hours: Daily, roughly 08:00–18:00 — check on the day
madaba-map.tip: A 45-minute drive from Amman; combine it with Mount Nebo in one trip.

mansaf.name: Mansaf (national dish)
mansaf.price_text: ≈ JOD 6–12 per plate at a local restaurant
mansaf.hours: Lunch and dinner; many places serve it daily
mansaf.tip: Eat it with your right hand from the shared platter if you want the full experience.

mount-nebo.name: Mount Nebo
mount-nebo.hours: Daily, roughly 08:00–17:00 — check on the day
mount-nebo.tip: Clear days show the Dead Sea and Jericho; bring a jacket, it is windy up there.

rainbow-street.name: Rainbow Street walk
rainbow-street.price_text: Free to walk; cafés and shops extra
rainbow-street.hours: Best from late morning to evening; liveliest after dark
rainbow-street.tip: Start at the 1st Circle and walk down for cafés, bookshops and street art.

jabal-amman-view.name: Viewpoint over Downtown from Jabal Amman
jabal-amman-view.tip: The hillside terraces near the 1st Circle give the classic view of the Roman Theater below.

hashem-restaurant.name: Falafel breakfast at a Downtown institution
hashem-restaurant.price_text: ≈ JOD 2–4 for falafel, hummus and tea
hashem-restaurant.tip: Cheap, fast and always busy — go before 10:00 to skip the queue.

jordan-museum.name: The Jordan Museum
jordan-museum.price_text: ≈ JOD 5 entry; check for student rates
jordan-museum.hours: Closed Monday; roughly 09:00–17:00 other days — check on the day
jordan-museum.tip: Good air-conditioned introduction to Jordan's history before you head to the sites.

food-tour.name: Downtown food walking tour
food-tour.price_text: ≈ JOD 20–35 per person, food included — confirm when booking
food-tour.tip: Book a small-group tour to taste knafeh, falafel and mansaf with local context.

souk-jara.name: Souk Jara street market (summer)
souk-jara.price_text: Free to enter; crafts and food extra
souk-jara.hours: Summer Friday evenings only — check dates on the day
souk-jara.tip: Local crafts, food stalls and music on Rainbow Street; cash is easiest.

abdoun-view.name: Abdoun hillside cafés and view
abdoun-view.hours: Cafés open late into the night
abdoun-view.tip: Modern Amman at its most polished — good for an evening coffee with a city view.

shmeisani-walk.name: Shmeisani café and gallery stroll
shmeisani-walk.price_text: Free to walk; drinks and galleries extra
shmeisani-walk.tip: A calm, leafy district for a break from Downtown crowds and heat.

dead-sea-day-trip.name: Dead Sea day trip from Amman
dead-sea-day-trip.price_text: ≈ JOD 35–60 shared tour; resort day pass extra
dead-sea-day-trip.hours: Full-day tours usually leave early morning
dead-sea-day-trip.tip: Bring water shoes and rinse off salt quickly; the drive is about an hour each way.

jerash-day-trip.name: Jerash Roman ruins day trip
jerash-day-trip.price_text: ≈ JOD 10 entry; transport extra — Jordan Pass covers entry
jerash-day-trip.hours: Site roughly 08:00–17:00 — check on the day
jerash-day-trip.tip: One of the best-preserved Roman cities in the region; go early to beat the heat.

cooking-class.name: Jordanian cooking class
cooking-class.price_text: ≈ JOD 25–40 per person — confirm when booking
cooking-class.tip: Learn to make maqluba or mansaf; a good rainy-day or hot-afternoon option.

king-abdullah-mosque.name: King Abdullah I Mosque
king-abdullah-mosque.hours: Outside prayer times; check on the day
king-abdullah-mosque.tip: The blue dome is striking; women should cover hair and shoulders.

downtown-hammam.name: Turkish bath (hammam) in Downtown
downtown-hammam.tip: A traditional scrub and steam is a relaxing end to a walking day.

wadi-rum-tour.name: Wadi Rum overnight tour (from Amman)
wadi-rum-tour.price_text: ≈ JOD 100–150 including transport, jeep tour and camp — confirm inclusions
wadi-rum-tour.tip: Book ahead in high season and check whether dinner and jeep tour are included.

stays.why: Walk to the Citadel, Roman Theatre and Hashemite Plaza. Cheapest base and best for street food.
Quiet, leafy streets near Rainbow Street cafés. Good middle ground between old and new Amman.
Upscale, calm and close to restaurants and malls. Best if you want quiet nights and easy taxis.
Modern business district with hotels and cafés. Central for the BRT and short rides to most sights.

food: Start with falafel and hummus at a downtown shop; a full plate is often under 3 JOD.
Try mansaf, the national dish of lamb cooked in yogurt, for a bigger sit-down meal.
Rainbow Street and Jabal Amman have cafés and sweet shops; knafeh is the local dessert to order.
Cheap eats: shawarma, falafel and fuul sandwiches for about 1–3 JOD.
Book a popular restaurant for Friday lunch; many places are busy and some close early on Fridays.
more_time: Add a day trip to Jerash for Roman ruins; check bus and tour options on the day.
Swap an afternoon for Madaba and Mount Nebo, known for mosaics and views.
Float in the Dead Sea: a long half-day trip; check transport and prices on the day.
